publisher: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), Working Group III
series: IPCC Special Report on Emissions Scenarios (SRES)
notes: Six illustrative scenarios (markers A1B, A2, B1, B2 and illustrative A1FI, A1T) of the 40 SRES scenarios. SRES prints decadal values (1990, 2000, 2010, ...), so 2005, 2015 and 2025 are absent. Emission values match TAR WG I Appendix II Table II.1.1/II.1.2 exactly. CO2 concentrations are from TAR (2001), flagged with published_in. The other 34 SRES scenarios are not captured.

entries.subject: global greenhouse gas emissions pathway
entries.quote: The A1 storyline and scenario family describes a future world of very rapid economic growth, global population that peaks in mid-century and declines thereafter, and the rapid introduction of new and more efficient technologies. ... distinguished by their technological emphasis: fossil intensive (A1FI), non-fossil energy sources (A1T), or a balance across all sources (A1B).
entries.position: SRES Summary for Policymakers, storylines
entries.note: Published as 'Marker Scenario A1B-AIM'. The quote describes the A1 family and its three technology groups.

entries.quote: The B2 storyline and scenario family describes a world in which the emphasis is on local solutions to economic, social, and environmental sustainability.
